newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq weakens in line with Dow in choppy session.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq weakens in line with Dow in choppy session.

text.p: Nasdaq shares ended lower Wednesday after a choppy session in which over-the-counter stocks mirrored gyrations in the Dow industrials, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index lost 6.19 points or 0.43 percent to close unofficially at 1446.24. The Dow industrials closed at 7689, down 68 points, amid weakness in the bond market. Nasdaq shares traded in a wide 28-point range, hitting a high of 1467.29 and a low of 1439.10. Declining issues beat gainers 2361 to 2039 on heavy volume of about 675.4 million shares.
"There's been so many rumors out there about the market today. The Nasdaq pretty much followed the rest of the market," one trader said.
Liposome Co Inc shares fell almost 62 percent to 9-9/16 after the company said its lead product in development failed to demonstrate efficacy in Phase III clinical trials.

Gadzooks Inc lost 15-1/2 to 20-1/8 after the company said it expects its second quarter sales and earnings to fall short of current analysts' estimates due, in part, to a sudden shift in junior apparel fashion trends.
Large capitalization technology stocks were weak overall.
